PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 255 of Block 01, con-tained in the Cadastral Map No. 420060, situated in the Village of Thumbana within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 619 - Kos-gollepola in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Rideegama, in the District of Kurunegala, in the Province of North Western, referred to in for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2041/31 of 20th October, 2017 in terms of Section 55 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 09th August, 2018.
